english:
Taking 50 damage grants a stack of 'Built Bitter'. Maximum of 10 stacks after receiving 500 damage. Self-damage does not count.

Built Bitter grants 6? Reload Speed and 1% decreased Reload Animation Duration per stack, up to 60 Reload Speed and 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration at 10 stacks.

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

source.text:
2 Piece | Built Bitter

Grants a stack of Built Bitter for every 50 damage taken, up to 10 stacks after receiving 500 damage.
Self damage does not count. Stacks are lost when stowing.

Built Bitter grants +6? Reload Speed and 0.99x Reload Duration Multiplier per stack until stowed.
Grants up to +60 Reload Speed and 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier.
